title: Retries that resend an event under a new id
intent: Review the design proposal in `design.md`, which adds retries to the order-event webhook.
statement: I read `design.md`. The retry schedule covers a 31-minute outage, the delivery state is stored before the first attempt, a failed delivery raises an alert, and `replay` covers the rest. The acceptance criteria follow from the proposal. I find no blocking issue and propose adopting the design as written.

problems.summary: every retry gets a new X-Delivery-Id and the subscriber has no way to detect a repeated event, so a timeout after the subscriber processed the event makes it act twice (for example a second receipt email)

locations.anchor: no field for detecting a repeated event
